summary: Grab Holdings filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report, US equivalent of an 8-K) furnishing a press release on routine board succession, not a special situation. Effective October 31, 2026, independent director John Rogers retires after a five-year term from the Board and Audit Committee and becomes an advisor for transition. Effective December 1, 2026, Sean Sullivan, EVP and CFO of Acushnet Holdings (NYSE: GOLF), joins the Board and Audit Committee. No terms, stake, price, or advisors were disclosed; no deal mechanics or regulatory clock apply. Watch for governance continuity, not arbitrage.
